page.title: Messages
page.selectServer: Select a server to view messages.
spy.selectQueueHint: Select a queue above to start watching messages.
spy.aboutDesc: Spy taps a queue you choose and streams messages in real time — without touching the broker or consuming the messages.
mode.tipLive: Live tail shows broker metadata in real time. Tracing is best-effort under load, and only events that arrive after the page opens are visible.
mode.tipQuery: History searches the Tracing archive over a time range. Use it to investigate something that happened before you opened the page.
filter.rangeExceedsRetention: Range starts before the {{days}}-day retention window — older events are not stored.
filter.rangeInverted: From must be earlier than To.
stats.label: Tracing statistics
payload.title: Payload
payload.metadataOnly: Body not captured ({{size}}). Tracing stores metadata only — use Spy to inspect message bodies.
properties.title: Properties
live.description: New messages will appear here as they're captured. Capture is best-effort.
live.errorHint: The subscription to the broker stopped or the network dropped. Retry to reconnect; events captured during the gap are still queryable in History.
query.noResults: No events in this time range.
empty.firehose.title: Tracing not enabled on this server
empty.firehose.description: Tracing turns on the RabbitMQ Firehose so Qarote captures every published and delivered message's metadata. Coverage is broker-wide and best-effort under high load.
empty.firehose.enableError: Failed to enable Tracing. Check server connectivity.
empty.firehose.enabledSuccess: Tracing enabled. Events will start arriving in a few seconds.
empty.firehose.confirmDescription: This activates the rabbitmq_tracing plugin on every selected vhost. On high-throughput brokers it adds 5–15% CPU overhead. Capture is best-effort: messages may be dropped under sustained load. Disable Tracing when you're done investigating.
empty.managementApi.title: Management API unavailable
empty.managementApi.description: The RabbitMQ Management Plugin is unreachable. Check that it is enabled and accessible on the broker.
page.errorHint: Reload the page to try again.
preview.liveBanner: Free plan preview — showing the first {{count}} events. Upgrade for unlimited live tail.
preview.queryBanner: Free plan preview — showing the most recent {{count}} events from the last 24 hours. Upgrade for full History access.
docs.helpLabel: Tracing vs Spy — open the guide (opens in new tab)
docs.spyAlternativeIntro: Need to inspect a single queue without enabling Tracing?
